{{Top|leg}}
Impact armor was designed to help absorb some of the wear-and-tear [[Droid/Legends|droids]] could have encountered in an active workplace. The '''impact armor Mark I''' was little more than a dust cover for the internal components of droids, nonetheless it was a considerable improvement over nothing.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.
